items.reason: AC5 (Ships to readable at phone width) fails. Every column gets an equal share of the row, and min-width:0 plus overflow-wrap:anywhere lets the Ships to cell shrink to one character, so the existing <=480px flex-wrap rule never moves it to its own line. The text breaks after every letter.

items.reason: AC5 (Ships to readable at phone width) fails. Every column gets an equal share of the row, and min-width:0 plus overflow-wrap:anywhere lets the Ships to cell shrink to one character, so the existing <=480px flex-wrap rule never moves it to its own line. The text breaks after every letter.
items.fix: In the existing @media (max-width:480px) block, give .order-ships-to the full row width (e.g. flex-basis:100% with an order that keeps it after Date), or switch to overflow-wrap:break-word so the cell keeps a word-wide minimum and wraps at spaces. Only an unbroken long word should break. Check at 375px that 'Redmond, U.S.' fits on one or two lines.
